meaning_en: To give suggestions about what someone should do.
example_en: I advise you to study hard.
examples_extra: The doctor advised him to rest for a week.
I advise you to check the timetable before leaving.
note_fa: تلفظ با /z/ است؛ بعد از آن to می‌آید: advise sb to do.

meaning_en: to say yes to a suggestion
example_en: She agreed to help me with my homework.
examples_extra: She agreed to help us with the move.
They agreed a price and shook hands.
note_fa: ساختارها: agree to + فعل؛ agree on/about + موضوع.

meaning_en: To request something from someone.
example_en: She asked her friend for help.
examples_extra: She asked him for help with the heavy box.
He asked his boss for a day off.

meaning_en: To try to do something, often difficult.
example_en: He made an attempt to climb the mountain.
examples_extra: His first attempt at skiing ended in a funny fall.
She attempted to climb the mountain alone last year.
note_fa: attempt to do یعنی «تلاش برای انجام».

meaning_en: To stay away from someone or something.
example_en: Try to avoid eating too much sugar.
examples_extra: I try to avoid driving in heavy traffic.
She avoided answering the reporter's difficult questions yesterday.
note_fa: بعد از آن فعل ing می‌آید، نه to.

meaning_en: To say someone caused a problem or mistake.
meaning_fa: کسی را برای چیزی سرزنش کردن
example_en: They blamed him for the accident.
examples_extra: Do not blame me for your own mistakes.
They blamed the driver for the accident on the bridge.

meaning_en: To think carefully about something.
example_en: I will consider your offer carefully.
examples_extra: Please consider my suggestion carefully.
We are considering moving to a bigger house.

meaning_en: To make someone believe something is true.
example_en: I tried to convince him to come.
examples_extra: I convinced my father to buy a new car.
She finally convinced them to join the trip.
note_fa: «قانع کردن»؛ convince somebody to do something.

meaning_en: To ask for something very firmly.
example_en: She demanded to know the truth.
examples_extra: The passengers demanded an explanation for the delay.
She demanded to see the manager immediately.
note_fa: قوی‌تر از ask؛ تقاضای جدی و محکم: demand an apology.

meaning_en: To give someone hope or confidence.
example_en: My teacher encouraged me to study harder.
examples_extra: Teachers should encourage students to ask questions.
Her parents encouraged her to study music.
note_fa: بعدش معمولاً to + فعل می‌آید: encourage him to try.

meaning_en: To like doing something.
example_en: I enjoy playing football with friends.
examples_extra: They enjoy travelling by train.
She enjoys reading before bed.
note_fa: بعد از enjoy همیشه فعل + ing می‌آید، نه to: enjoy swimming درست است.

meaning_en: To think something will happen.
example_en: I expect my friend to arrive soon.
examples_extra: We expect the guests to arrive at six.
I didn't expect such a warm welcome.

meaning_en: To dislike something very much.
meaning_fa: متنفر بودن، از چیزی بد آمدن
example_en: I hate waking up early.
examples_extra: I hate getting up early on cold mornings.
She hates spiders more than anything else.
note_fa: متنفر بودن؛ با -ing یا to می‌آید.

meaning_en: To make it easier for someone to do something.
example_en: Can you help me carry these bags?
examples_extra: Could you please help me with my homework?
She helped the old lady cross the road.

meaning_en: To wish for a specific outcome.
example_en: I hope that you feel better soon.
examples_extra: I hope that it will not rain tomorrow.
She hopes that he will come.

meaning_en: To want and expect to do something.
example_en: I hope to visit Japan next year.
examples_extra: I hope to visit Paris next year.
They hope to finish by Friday.

meaning_en: To form a picture or idea in your mind.
example_en: Imagine a world where everyone is happy.
examples_extra: Imagine living on the moon!
I can't imagine life without music.

meaning_en: To demand firmly that something happens.
example_en: He insisted on paying for the meal.
examples_extra: They always insist on doing everything themselves.
My mother insists on doing the dishes after dinner.
note_fa: اصرار بر انجام کاری؛ بعدش ing.

meaning_en: To plan or mean to do something.
example_en: I intend to finish this work today.
examples_extra: We intend to visit them in spring.
She intends to study medicine at university.

meaning_en: To speak about something briefly.
example_en: Did he mention his new job?
examples_extra: She didn't mention the meeting.
He mentioned that he was tired.
note_fa: یعنی به‌اختصار گفتن؛ mention + that رایج است.

meaning_en: To object to or be bothered by something.
example_en: Do you mind opening the window?
examples_extra: Do you mind opening the window?
I don't mind waiting for a few minutes.
note_fa: الگو: mind + ing؛ Do you mind if I ...? هم رایج است.

meaning_en: To see or become aware of something.
example_en: I didn't notice you were here.
examples_extra: I did not notice the mistake until the end.
Did you notice her new haircut?
note_fa: متوجه شدن؛ با that یا اسم می‌آید.

meaning_en: To ask someone if they want something.
example_en: He offered me a cup of tea.
examples_extra: She offered me a cup of tea.
They offered him the job yesterday.
note_fa: offer to do یعنی پیشنهاد انجام کاری: offered to help.

meaning_en: To make someone agree to do something.
example_en: I persuaded him to join the team.
examples_extra: She persuaded him to join us.
They couldn't persuade her to stay.

meaning_en: To tell someone you will definitely do something.
example_en: I promise you that I will help.
examples_extra: He promised that he would help.
She promised that she was telling the truth.

meaning_en: To say you will certainly do something.
example_en: He promised to call me later.
examples_extra: She promised to do the washing-up.
He promised to do the job later.

meaning_en: to understand or become aware of something
example_en: I suddenly realised my mistake.
examples_extra: I suddenly realised that I had left my keys at home.
She realised her mistake too late.
note_fa: متوجه شدن؛ در آمریکا realize نوشته می‌شود.

meaning_en: To suggest doing something.
example_en: I recommend visiting the museum while you're here.
examples_extra: I recommend booking the tickets in advance.
Doctors recommend walking for half an hour daily.

meaning_en: To suggest that someone should do something.
example_en: I recommend that you book your flight early.
examples_extra: I recommend that you visit the museum early.
She recommended that he see a doctor.

meaning_en: To make someone remember something.
example_en: Please remind me to call him later.
examples_extra: Remind me to call the doctor tomorrow.
She reminded him about the meeting.

meaning_en: To state a fact or opinion.
example_en: She said that she was tired.
examples_extra: She will say that she was tired.
They say that it will rain.
note_fa: گفتنِ یک جمله/نظر؛ that قابل حذف است.

meaning_en: To offer an idea for doing something.
example_en: I suggest going to the park this afternoon.
examples_extra: I suggest going by train.
They suggested leaving early in the morning.

meaning_en: To say an idea or plan for others to think about.
example_en: She suggested that we meet at 7 PM.
examples_extra: I suggest that we wait.
He suggested that she apply.

meaning_en: Inform someone about something.
example_en: She told me that she was busy.
examples_extra: He tells me that he is busy.
They tell us that the train is late.
note_fa: «به کسی خبر دادن»؛ tell sb that.

meaning_en: to imagine or consider doing something.
example_en: I'm thinking of going to the beach.
examples_extra: Think of joining us for the trip this summer.
I can’t think of a better place to live.
note_fa: به فکر انجام کاری بودن؛ تصور کردن.

meaning_en: To tell someone about a possible danger or problem.
example_en: I warned him not to touch the hot stove.
examples_extra: They warned us all to stay safely inside.
I must warn you not to go there.
note_fa: هشدار دادن؛ warn sb to do.

meaning_en: Used to say that mistakes or unfortunate events are unavoidable.
example_en: Don't worry about the spilled milk; accidents will happen!
examples_extra: Don't worry; accidents will happen!
Accidents will happen, so stay calm.

meaning_en: Clearly visible or understood; obvious.
example_en: It became apparent that he was lying.
examples_extra: It was apparent that she was unhappy.
His disappointment was apparent to everyone.

meaning_en: A strong hope or ambition of achieving something.
example_en: His main aspiration is to become a successful entrepreneur.
examples_extra: Her aspiration is to become a doctor.
The job fulfilled his aspirations.

meaning_en: Certain or very likely to happen.
example_en: With all this rain, it's bound to flood.
examples_extra: It is bound to rain this weekend.
She is bound to pass the exam.

meaning_en: To meet someone unexpectedly.
example_en: I bumped into an old friend at the supermarket.
examples_extra: I bumped into an old friend.
She bumped into him at the market.
note_fa: اتفاقی کسی را دیدن؛ bump into somebody.

meaning_en: It is likely or probable that something will happen.
example_en: The chances are he'll be late again.
examples_extra: The chances are it will rain.
The chances are she forgot.

meaning_en: To strongly wish or want something.
example_en: He desires to achieve success in his career.
examples_extra: She deeply desires lasting success and fame.
He secretly desired a shiny new car badly.

meaning_en: Very keen and enthusiastic to do something.
example_en: She was eager to start her new job.
examples_extra: The eager young students asked many good questions.
She is extremely eager to learn even more.

meaning_en: Certainly; definitely.
example_en: I know for sure that he'll be there.
examples_extra: I know for sure she's coming.
One thing's for sure: it won't be easy.

meaning_en: Expresses doubt or sarcasm about a desirable but unlikely event.
example_en: Win the lottery? I should be so lucky!
examples_extra: A pay rise? I should be so lucky!
Win the lottery? I should be so lucky!

meaning_en: Very likely to happen; almost certainly.
example_en: In all probability, the project will be completed on time.
examples_extra: In all probability, it will rain tomorrow.
In all probability, she'll win.

meaning_en: The probability or chance of something happening.
example_en: There's a high likelihood of rain tomorrow.
examples_extra: There is little likelihood of rain.
The likelihood is that prices will rise.

meaning_en: To have a strong desire or yearning for something.
example_en: She longed to see her family again.
examples_extra: She longed to see her family again soon.
He longed for the quiet days of his youth.
note_fa: «دلتنگ بودن و آرزو کردن»؛ long for و long to.

meaning_en: It is unlikely to happen; chances are low.
meaning_fa: احتمال کم است، شانس کم است
example_en: The odds are against us winning this game.
examples_extra: The odds are against us.
The odds are he'll win.

meaning_en: A choice or possibility.
example_en: We have the option to either stay or leave.
examples_extra: We have no other option.
That's a very good option.

meaning_en: Extremely happy and delighted.
example_en: She was overjoyed to hear about her promotion.
examples_extra: They were absolutely overjoyed today.
She was overjoyed at the news.

meaning_en: having made a firm decision to do something
example_en: He resolved to finish the project by Friday.
examples_extra: She was resolved to succeed.
He felt resolved and calm.

meaning_en: Without doubt; certainly.
example_en: Unquestionably, she is the most talented singer in the group.
examples_extra: He is unquestionably the best candidate.
The film was unquestionably a success.

meaning_en: feeling anxious or concerned about something.
example_en: She was worried about her upcoming exam results.
examples_extra: She looks worried about today.
He was worried about the exam.

meaning_en: an expression of disbelief or surprise.
example_en: "I won the lottery!" "You must be joking!"
examples_extra: You must be joking! Really?
You want a thousand? You must be joking!
note_fa: کتاب: You must be joking!؛ ابراز ناباوری.
